catalog.container_strategy: Preserve exact source and notices in immutable prepared materials. A reference adapter does not install or start this resource.
catalog.purpose: Author-maintained compiler repair harness and live benchmark reference, formerly llvm-autofix. Preserve golden fixes, discussions and issue metadata for developer-selected use; this is separate from the Tian et al. LLVM-Bench paper.
qualification_gaps: Source qualification does not demonstrate build, container, runtime service or dependency closure readiness.

Upstream Dockerfiles use floating base image tags and installation scripts fetch dependencies. Prepare separate pinned LLVM/Alive2/backend-TV/parser/agent Python capsules before executing the harness.
Author-provided experiment branch is distinct from current main; this pin is not claimed to reproduce the paper artifact.
Golden patches, discussions, issue histories and test answers are preserved; the developer chooses whether to include them in an Environment.
This repository's llvm-bench is distinct from Tian et al. LLVM-Bench/LLVM-Gym, arXiv:2607.00700.
catalog.size_basis: Complete HTTPS payload measured locally; source logical bytes sum regular archive members and exclude filesystem allocation, external dependencies and build trees.
